remarks: Welcome to 33 Maple! Located in the Village of Bemus Point making it easy to enjoy the lakeside and community activities year-round. Conveniently located one block from restaurants, shops & a grocery store. Other Bemus Point amenities include a library, post office, credit union, golf course, elementary school, fire department, the lakeside park & churches. The covered front porch leads you into a bright, spacious first floor with a living room, dining room, bedroom(den/office), eat in kitchen, newly remodeled bathroom, laundry room & mud room. From the attached garage enter into the mudroom at the back of the house. The garage has room for a vehicle & storage. The second floor has four additional bedrooms. One bedroom has a large attached unfinished space that provides the room to add a second-floor bathroom or have a large walk-in closet. **Bathroom remodel rendition attached** Dry basement for storage & mechanicals.  Some special features of the house include oak wood flooring in the living room & dining room, trim work, marble tile flooring in the bathroom, tile backsplash in the kitchen, bead board on some walls, a bay window & wood beams in the living room. Enjoy the backyard for dining and gardening. The outside of the house has vinyl siding for easy maintenance. Updates include new roof 2021, first floor bathroom renovation 2023, new well 2024, refinished wood floors and installed new carpet 2023, new well pressure tank & tankless hot water heater 2023, new garage door opener & sidewalk 2025. Don't miss this well-maintained home with off-street parking in a wonderful location & only one block to the lake! Dock slip available for rent one block from the house. The Village of Bemus Point is a great place to call home. Bemus Point is located on the east side of Chautauqua Lake convenient to Lakewood, Jamestown, Westfield & more with easy access to I86.
